1445-4871-6277-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-6277-8095.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

997-3652-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
997-3652-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ornithopter, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

3488-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3488-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3488-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3899-5961--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

1778-4053-4247-6989.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

4231-4321-5777-7824.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods, two Clues, two Treasures and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.
4231-4321-5777-7824.notes: You can replace step 1 with using the Food's own ability to sacrifice it.

2232-7827-7830-7837.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7837.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5089-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4552-5089-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3499-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3499-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3499-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

240-647-2034-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4559-4802-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-5231-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-6112-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-6112-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Fumulus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

57-4846-6633-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6633-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2457-3129-4289-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2099-2558-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2099-2558-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Sarcatog to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

413-2178-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
413-2178-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4053-5256--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5256--73.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

56-443-4976-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-4976-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Open the Graves trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

851-3062-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
851-3062-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

372-961-2187.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-2187.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-4543-4862.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-4543-4862.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Omnath trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

628-864-2034-2596-3944.notablePrerequisites: Blood Pet does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-864-2034-2596-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mikaeus, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards in their graveyards, sacrifice all creatures they control, then put all cards exiled this way onto the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Living Death to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1799-2034-2048-4242.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
1799-2034-2048-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

57-914-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
57-914-1636.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

1339-2899-3394.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
1339-2899-3394.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

236-1283-1978.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Bring to Life.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4013-4840.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

364-614-1964-1987.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
